title: A `foreach` binding may write `var` wherever a local declaration may, and means what it means there
scope:
The type position of a `foreach` key and value binding, `inout` included: what `var` there gives
the binding, and the one subject it refuses. `catch`, destructuring, parameters, properties,
constants, closures and returns keep their written types, and are not decided here.
dependsOnText:
[0037](0037.md) (`var` takes a local's type from its initializer),
[0053](0053.md) (what a `foreach` subject may be, and what its bindings type as),
[0007](0007.md) (every binding declares its type).
validatedBy:
the Stage 2 checks of goal `foreach-var`: three parser tests in
`crates/nvs-syntax/src/parser/tests/stmt.rs`, seven checker tests in
`crates/nvs-types/tests/locals.rs`, and the two `.nvst` cases named under *Verification*.
